observations: Photo 0: Close-up of an engine valve cover stamped 'DAF 24 VALVE' and a cylinder head marked 'DAF' with a partial number '1428063'.
Photo 0: Visible watermark 'HEPH AUTOS' and 'POSTED ON JIJI', surface grime, oxidation and oil residue on metal parts.
Photo 1: Engine sits outdoors on bare ground, partially covered by a dirty tarp, surrounded by other stripped engines, axles and gearbox casings.
Photo 2: Multiple similar engines stacked together under tarps in what looks like an open scrapyard or parts yard, not a workshop.
No data plate, serial number, hour meter, oil dipstick, or engine bay (installed in chassis) view is visible in any photo.
No video, sound, or smoke evidence of the engine running is shown despite claim 'tested and working'.

read_from: photo 0 cylinder head text 'DAF' and number '1428063'

claims.claim: Clean and powerful, in excellent condition, ready for work
claims.evidence: Photo 1 and 2 show the engine stored outdoors, dirty, oxidized, and stacked amid scrap parts, not in a condition suggesting 'clean' or immediately installable.
No import documents, shipping labels, or markings indicating origin are visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: No start-up video, compression test, hour meter, or sealed-bolt evidence is shown in any photo.

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal wear (rings, bearings, injectors) despite 'tested' claim.
risks.proof: A video clip of the engine being started and run, showing exhaust smoke color and sound.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / needing full diagnostic

risks.risk: Engine exposed to open-air weather (tarp only) risking rust on internals, corrosion of sensors and wiring.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the oil fill cap, dipstick, and intake manifold interior for rust or water ingress.
risks.if_unproven: priced as weather-damaged risk, same as not working

risks.risk: Possible parts mixing or mismatched components since many engines are piled together in the yard.
risks.proof: A photo of the full engine isolated, showing it is complete as one unit with matching plate numbers.

risks.risk: No visible identification plate confirming exact engine model/displacement, which affects compatibility and price tier.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine ID/serial plate.
risks.if_unproven: priced at base DAF diesel engine tier, unconfirmed model

risks.risk: Claim of 'never opened' cannot be confirmed; head bolts or seals may show prior disassembly.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of head bolt seals and valve cover gasket area for tool marks.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly opened/reconditioned, not original factory seal

proof_requests: Video of the engine running (start-up, idle, and revving) with audible sound.
Clear photo of the engine's identification/serial plate for exact model confirmation.
Photos of the engine fully removed from the pile, showing all sides including oil pan and wiring harness.
Documentation or photos of import paperwork supporting 'direct from Belgium' claim.
Close-up of head bolts and gasket seams to assess if engine was previously opened.
response.reason: The engine is identifiable by brand (DAF) and type (trailer head diesel engine) from photo 0, but all performance and condition claims are unverified or contradicted by the dirty, outdoor, stacked storage shown in photos 1 and 2, so it must be priced at worst case as an unverified, possibly non-running used engine.
